cause.what_happened: No new catalyst on 2026-10-12. The selling continues the reaction to the 2026-10-09 non-binding letter of intent to buy a ~6 MW (path to 36 MW) US data center with no price or funding plan disclosed. Investors are questioning how a ~$279m market cap company with $125m-plus of 7.5% converts and $228m of committed equipment purchases pays for it. 24/7 Wall St at 12:56 ET put the stock at $10.18, down 9%, with peers and SPY roughly flat. The closest label is a strategy/financing worry, not a contract loss; no listed label fits exactly.
